name: Clement Michel
source:
Clement is a stable man who is very easy-going… other than at work. As a boss, he has no patience for incompetence among the trained professionals in his kitchen. However, as a teacher he is kind and willing to help through MC’s mistakes. This is easy to understand when you consider the circumstances: people working in the kitchen have been trained and know better than to make foolish mistakes. The MC, however, has no experience in a kitchen, and thus their mistakes are inevitable as they learn.

Clement loves his dog and his little sister more than life itself. After the death of their single mother, Clement took it upon himself to raise his little sister and help put her through school. As he freely admits, she is much more intelligent than him, and he doesn't want her to miss any opportunities in life, so he works as hard as he can to help her.

[From strategy guide]
